target.game: Need for Speed: Most Wanted - Black Edition (NTSC-U)

patches.name: Remove 2005 Brown/Yellow Visual Treatment
patches.description: Skips the heavy sepia/amber color-wash pass in IVisualTreatmentPlat::ApplyColorBloom and uses neutral RGBA compositing for crisp, modern natural colors while retaining bloom.
patches.author: fobes (independently MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51 by Rockport 2026)

writes.note: ApplyColorBloom (0x0021931C, 0x002196FC): skip sepia tint sprite pass and force neutral bloom color

patches.name: Remove Smeared PS2 Motion Blur (Clean, Preserves Bloom)
patches.description: Disables the low-res PS2 smear/accumulation motion blur inside eAttachSmear2 without killing bloom or other post-processing passes.
patches.author: Steelmax / PCSX2 community & NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (independently MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: eAttachSmear2 (0x002146CC): SmearEnable 1 -> 0 (skips smear DMA draw submission cleanly)

patches.name: True Native 16:9 Widescreen (Auto-Default ON + 0.75f Projection)
patches.description: Fixes NTSC 16:9 horizontal 3D projection from EA's overscanned 0.71f to exact 0.75f (3/4) and patches VideoSettings::Default() to default WideScreen = 1 (exact integer bool 1 so in-game Options toggle still works cleanly on standalone modded ISOs without .pnach).
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: MaybeChangeViewMode (0x00201578): NTSC 16:9 AspectRatio3dx 0.71f -> 0.75f (propagated via UpdateGifTags to TARGET_PLAYER1+0x60 at 0x00553430)
VideoSettings::Default (0x0026D9F0): mtc1 $at,$f0 -> sw $at,0x0($a0) (stores 1.0f directly via GPR $at)
VideoSettings::Default: sw $zero,0xc($a0) -> li $at,1 (clean integer 1 for WideScreen flag)
VideoSettings::Default: swc1 $f0,0x0($a0) -> sw $at,0xc($a0) (defaults WideScreen ON while keeping menu xori 1 toggle intact)

patches.name: Force Highest Available Car & Wheel LOD
patches.description: Enables EA's built-in g_ForceCarBodyLOD and g_ForceCarTireLOD overrides in CarRenderInfo::Render, which are safely clamped via R5900 pmaxw/pminw to each vehicle's [mMinLodLevel, mMaxLodLevel] so racer/cop cars stay at LOD A at all distances and traffic cars safely use their highest mesh.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: CarRenderInfo::Render (0x003EC7A4): g_ForceCarBodyLOD -1 -> 0 (LOD A, clamped to mMinLodLevel)
CarRenderInfo::Render (0x003EC7CC): g_ForceCarTireLOD -1 -> 0 (LOD A, clamped to mMinLodLevel)

patches.name: Full-Rate 5-Face Real-Time Car Reflections
patches.description: Bypasses the PS2 5-frame round-robin cubemap throttle in IsFaceEnabled() so all 5 visible environment-map reflection faces update every single frame instead of staggered partial updates.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: IsFaceEnabled (0x0020F598): beq $v0,$zero,0x20F684 -> b 0x20F684 (always uses full-face table 0x0054FE50 [1,1,0,1,1,1])

patches.name: Extended Scenery Draw Distance & High-Detail World LOD
patches.description: Lowers ScenerySectionHeader::DrawAScenery projected-pixel cull cutoff from 18 px to 6 px (3x scenery visibility) and extends the high-detail world mesh LOD threshold from 8.7f to 3.0f (~2.9x further high-poly buildings and trees).
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: DrawAScenery (0x003DB110): slti $v0,$s0,0x12 (18 px cull) -> slti $v0,$s0,0x06 (6 px cull)

patches.name: Disable Bloom Post-Processing
patches.description: Skips the PS2 additive bloom pass inside IVisualTreatmentPlat::ApplyColorBloom for a razor-sharp, glare-free image at 4K.
patches.author: Steelmax / PCSX2 community (independently MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51 by Rockport 2026)

patches.name: Disable All Post-Processing (Master Visual Treatment Switch)
patches.description: Turns off IVisualTreatmentPlat::RenderMWVisualLook entirely, disabling sepia tint, bloom, detail map softening, and pulse brightness in one switch. Also eliminates any remaining upscaled post-effect offset.
patches.author: Steelmax / PCSX2 community (independently MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51 by Rockport 2026)

patches.name: Disable High-Speed / Nitrous Radial Blur
patches.description: Early-returns IVisualTreatmentPlat::Radialblur so high-speed and NOS screen-edge radial blur never obscures peripheral visibility at 4K.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: No Distant Fog (FogModeInfos[0])
patches.description: Clears the FogModeInfos[0] mode byte (0x00550029, read via eAttachFog @ 0x00211404) to remove distant horizon fog.
patches.author: Steelmax / PCSX2 community (independently MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51 by Rockport 2026)

writes.note: FogModeInfos[0] (0x00550028): clears byte at 0x00550029 from 0x01 to 0x00 (4-byte aligned word)

patches.name: Disable Camera Lens Raindrop Overlays
patches.description: Early-returns RainDrop() to disable low-res screen-space water droplets on the camera lens while preserving wet road reflections and rain ambience.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: Ultrawide 21:9 (64:27) Aspect Ratio + Widened Frustum Culling
patches.description: Alternative to widescreen_16_9_native: sets NTSC 16:9 horizontal 3D scale to 0.5625f (9/16 = exact 64:27 cinema ultrawide) and widens CreateViewMatricies frustum culling width (0.71f -> 0.90f) to eliminate left/right edge pop-in on 21:9 displays. Use via --only instead of widescreen_16_9_native.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: MaybeChangeViewMode -> CreateViewMatricies (0x00206938): frustum culling half-width factor 0.71f -> 0.90f to prevent 21:9 edge pop-in

patches.name: Wider 3D Camera FOV (+12% Symmetric on 16:9)
patches.description: Alternative to widescreen_16_9_native: scales both 3D X and Y projection factors down by 1.12x (0.75f -> 0.66964f, 1.10f -> 0.98214f) and widens frustum culling (0.71f -> 0.80f) for a wider modern racing FOV while keeping exact 16:9 aspect ratio and untouched 2D HUD.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: Disable AI Rubber-Banding / Catch-Up
patches.description: Forces GRaceParameters::GetCatchUp() to return 0, cleanly disabling AI catch-up rubber-banding in AIPerpVehicle::ComputeSkill and GRaceStatus::SyncronizeAdaptiveBonus.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: Skip Intro / FMV Movies
patches.description: Sets the engine's built-in SkipMovies flag (0x00574660 = 1) checked by MoviePlayer::Play and FEngMovieStarter::Callback so FMVs immediately emit MOVIE_DONE and boot straight to the main menu.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: Unlock All Cars, Tracks & Parts (Sandbox / Quick Race)
patches.description: Enables the engine's built-in UnlockAllThings flag (0x00574624 = 1) checked by QuickRaceUnlocker, CareerUnlocker, UnlockSystem, and GRaceParameters::GetIsAvailable.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: 60 FPS Companion: Fix ScreenEFX 30Hz Timestep
patches.description: SLUS_213.51 already runs physics/Scheduler at native 60 Hz with no 30 FPS cap enabled (0x0054B5D8=0); PCSX2 EE Overclock (180%-300%) unlocks true 60 FPS natively. This patch fixes the one hardcoded 1/30f (0x3D088889) timestep inside UpdateAllScreenEFX() to 1/60f (0x3C888889) so screen particle/weather effects run at true 1x speed at 60 FPS.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: Lock 30 FPS Frame Pacing (Smooth 30Hz Cap)
patches.description: Activates EA's hidden built-in 2-VBlank frame limiter in eDisplayFrame (0x0020DA9C, default 0) for perfectly even 30 FPS pacing during gameplay on hardware that cannot hold locked 60 FPS.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: eDisplayFrame (0x0020DA9C): enables while(VBlank - LastSwap < 2) WaitUntilVSync() during GAMEFLOW_STATE_RACING

patches.name: Real-Time Planar Damp-Asphalt Road Reflections (Dry + Sunny Weather)
patches.description: Unlocks the PS2 engine's native real-time planar road reflection pass (eView[4] -> RT 4) during dry sunlit racing in Rain::UpdateAndRender without triggering falling rain curtains, lens raindrops, or storm fog. Tunes g_MaxRoadDampness from 1.0f (flooded mirror) to 0.65f (realistic Forza-style damp autumn asphalt sheen) while leaving garage floor reflections untouched at 1.0f, and accelerates dampness fade-in (0.005f -> 0.05f/frame) so reflections appear within 0.5s of spawn.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: UpdateAndRender__4Rain (0x00407560): bc1t 0x00407570 -> nop (keeps mDesiredRoadDampness active when mRainIntensity == 0.0f)
UpdateAndRender__4Rain (0x0040756C): g_MaxRoadDampness 1.0f -> 0.65f (photorealistic damp asphalt reflection balance)
UpdateAndRender__4Rain (0x004075A0): mRoadDampness lerp rate 0.005f -> 0.05f (upper 16 bits, ~0.5s fade-in at spawn)

patches.name: High-Detail Car EnvMap & Road Reflection Scenery (2.6x More Reflected Buildings/Trees)
patches.description: Lowers ScenerySectionHeader::DrawAScenery projected-pixel cull cutoff for reflection/envmap views (SceneryCullInfo flag 0x20) from 32 px to 12 px so far more Rockport skyline buildings, bridges, and autumn trees appear inside real-time 5-face car reflections and planar road reflections.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS-verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: DrawAScenery (0x003DB0D4): slti $v0,$s0,0x20 (32 px reflection cull) -> slti $v0,$s0,0x0c (12 px reflection cull)

patches.name: Warm Late-Autumn Lighting, Cleared Mid-Fog & Balanced Road Dampness (v2.1)
patches.description: Warms FillLightDiffuseColour (0.87,0.90,1.00 -> 0.97,0.93,0.88), lifts FillLightDiffuseIntensity (2.1 -> 2.4), extends BaseWeatherFogStart/HorizWeatherFogStart (212/229 -> 340/380), and balances g_MaxRoadDampness (1.0 -> 0.52).
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS/ELF-verified for SLUS-21351)

patches.name: Golden-Hour 3D Sun-Shadow Depth & Visible Damp Road Reflections (v2.8)
patches.description: Raises PrimaryLightDiffuseIntensity (6.50 -> 8.80) over bright luminous sky FillLightDiffuse ([0.87,0.90,1.00]@2.10 -> [0.88,0.905,0.96]@2.15) for a crisp 4.09:1 golden-hour 3D separation without dark-wall crushing, clears mid-fog (340/380), and unlocks dry-weather planar road reflections capped at g_MaxRoadDampness=0.58f for visible reflective damp asphalt.
patches.author: NFSMW: Rockport 2026 (MIPS/ELF-verified for SLUS-21351)

writes.note: UpdateAndRender__4Rain: bc1t -> nop (allow planar damp road reflections in clear weather)
g_MaxRoadDampness 1.00f -> 0.58f (clearly visible damp-asphalt reflections, clean sidewalks)
